 Taylor Swift, Dolly Parton and Keith Urban recorded music at this 10-acre Tennessee estate; its studio is linked to more than 65 gold and platinum albums, and the property is listed for $19.5 million 
 TOI Lifestyle Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Nov 17, 2026, 09:40 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print From left to right: Taylor Swift, Dolly Parton and Keith Urban. Image Credits: Wikipedia A Tennessee estate associated with recordings by Taylor Swift , Dolly Parton and Keith Urban has entered the luxury property market with an asking price of $19.5 million. Known as Dark Horse Estate, the 10-acre property in Franklin combines a private residential setting with a professional recording studio whose history is linked to more than 65 gold and platinum albums. Its appeal extends beyond its celebrity connections, offering a rare combination of country music heritage, recording facilities and substantial private grounds. The listing puts the spotlight on a property where music-making and residential life have shared the same space. Dark Horse Estate offers a rare combination of music and luxury living
 The property at 2465 Old Charlotte Pike in Franklin, outside Nashville, is more than a conventional mansion. According to Realtor, Dark Horse Estate covers 10.01 acres and contains 23,138 square feet of interior space. The compound was built in 1998 and brings together several residential buildings, recording facilities and entertainment spaces. Zillow's property listing identifies it as a riverfront residence, with extensive grounds and multiple buildings that provide opportunities for both private living and entertaining. The property's musical reputation comes from Dark Horse Recording, a facility that has welcomed artists across different genres. Its official website says the studio is celebrating its 30th year, with more than 65 gold and platinum albums recorded there. The recording facility has hosted Taylor Swift, Keith Urban, Hunter Hayes, Korn, Matchbox Twenty and numerous other artists. Dark Horse Recording's official client list also includes independent and major-label musicians, reflecting its longstanding role in the recording industry. The studio's appeal is not limited to its list of famous visitors. Dark Horse Recording's website describes a facility equipped with both analogue and digital technology for recording, editing and mixing. The grounds are an equally important part of the experience, offering artists a peaceful environment away from the distractions of everyday life. The studios at Dark Horse Recording host a large array of analog and digital equipment to meet the most demanding recording, editing, and mixing needs. Image Credit: Dark Horse Studios The estate combines several residential and entertainment spaces
 The property is organised around Dark Horse Manor, Dark Horse Recording, The Cottage, The Bungalow Apartment and The Party Barn. Together, these buildings make it possible to accommodate residents, guests and musicians without requiring everyone to share the same living spaces. According to Realtor, the estate includes multiple studios, private guest quarters and areas designed for public gatherings. The listing also highlights a three-car garage and covered walkways that connect different parts of the compound. Dark Horse Manor encompasses more than 14,200 square feet across The Manor, The Cottage and The Bungalow Apartment. Covered walkways and a sky bridge connecting to a game room add to the property's distinctive layout. The architecture brings the outdoors into the property
 The estate's design places considerable emphasis on its surroundings. Realtor notes that more than 3,000 square feet of covered porches and walkways overlook the grounds, providing sheltered outdoor areas for relaxing or entertaining. Zillow describes the buildings as having heavy post-and-beam construction, with walls of glass that bring natural light into the interiors. The listing also identifies the property as having a rolling landscape and riverfront setting. The property also includes a Party Barn, giving it a dedicated space for gatherings separate from the residential buildings and recording rooms. Dark Horse Recording has built a history beyond celebrity visits
 The recording studio was established in Franklin in 1993, according to its official website. Its founder, Robin, moved to Tennessee after a career as a performer and recording artist, eventually developing Dark Horse into a four-studio destination. The studio's website describes its facilities as serving both major-label and independent artists. That broad client base has helped establish its reputation beyond any individual musician or album. Dark Horse also has a connection to music education through Dark Horse Institute, which Robin established in 2010. The institute was created to support the next generation of creative professionals.  A $19.5 million listing puts the estate in the luxury market
 The property is currently listed for $19.5 million, according to Realtor. The listing covers the entire 10.01-acre estate, including the residences, recording facilities and entertainment spaces. Zillow records an earlier listing at $24 million in August 2025, which was removed in August 2026. The property subsequently returned to the market at its current asking price in September 2026. At 23,138 square feet, the estate offers substantial interior space alongside its outdoor areas. Its 10 bedrooms and 15 bathrooms, as listed on Zillow, reflect the scale of the compound and its capacity to accommodate residents and guests.
